Healthcare revenue

Revenue cycle management.

Follow revenue from registration and eligibility through claim submission, payment posting and accounts receivable.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Before submission

Review coverage and authorisations, reconcile charges against documentation and flag missing information for the practice.

From claim to deposit

Scrub claims, track acceptance and handle rejections. Posted remittances are matched to deposits, with underpayments and denials identified for follow-up.

Choose the right scope

Your practice can select individual stages or the complete cycle. SuperBillOne LLC and Cloud Haven agree on responsibilities, priorities and reporting.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Baseline review and a written allocation of responsibilities.
  • Open balances and denials worklists for agreed stages.
  • Performance report using the measures agreed before launch.
Delivery partner

US healthcare operations.

Cloud Haven coordinates billing work with SuperBillOne LLC, a US-registered medical billing company in Austin, Texas. Your introductory call covers the practice workflow, payer mix and the responsibilities on each side.

Meet the billing partner
Questions

Before you start.

Can we outsource one stage first?

Yes. Some practices start with claims or accounts receivable and add denial management or front-desk checks later.

Which indicators will we see?

Typical measures include days in receivables, clean-claim and denial rates, and collection trends. The practice and team agree on the final set.

How does revenue cycle work extend beyond billing?

It can cover eligibility and registration before a claim, then reconciliation, follow-up and management reporting afterwards.

Field notes

Further reading.

Revenue cycle metrics to track

A revenue cycle meeting is more productive when everyone knows how the numbers were calculated and which actions each number can trigger.

What is revenue cycle management?

Revenue cycle management covers the administrative journey from the first registration details to the resolution of a healthcare account. Medical billing is one part of that wider workflow.
